extracted.stage: Litigant in person, hearing listed in divorce/financial proceedings
extracted.summary: Hannah, currently unrepresented in divorce proceedings with a hearing on 10 December, asks to borrow about £26,500 to fund representation, with roughly £149,000 of matrimonial assets (house and pension) in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for contacting Lodestar Legal Finance and for setting out your situation so clearly. Before we can look at your enquiry we would need a few more details: confirmation of where the proceedings are taking place and the court involved, the name of the solicitor you intend to instruct (and their cost estimate), and the type of hearing listed for 10 December. It would also help to have more detail on the matrimonial assets, including how the property and pension values were arrived at and whether any are jointly held. Once we have that information a member of our team will review your enquiry and come back to you. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or legal advice.
